name: Salmankaş Tunnel
facts: Salmankaş Tunnel, a 4,150‑meter twin‑tube marvel, opened December 20, 2019, cutting a 16‑kilometer stretch and slashing travel time from 2–3.5 hours to just 1.5 hours.
Construction, led by as‑yol Yapı A.Ş., cost ₺170 million and employed the New Austrian Tunnelling Method, with breakthrough achieved on November 24, 2013.
Built to bypass the 2,280‑meter Salmankaş Pass on the ancient Silk Road, the tunnel eliminates six‑month winter closures caused by snow, ice, and fog.
